assertions.text: Every output line matches the format '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)' with exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines)
Lines are grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is kept inside each group (dark mode before CSV export; empty-input crash before sync timeout)
The refactor bullet is typed CHORE and the docs bullet is typed DOCS
Each summary is sentence case, has no trailing period, and is at most 60 characters
